policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. Update measured counts in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances; never lower a floor without an explicit, justified scope change.

tolerance.rationale: Smart Client Refresh hardening adds a server-bound bootstrap baseline, atomic foreground-policy barrier, document-lifetime native pause and modal/write safety, interaction/media-settle idle tracking, monotonic state validation, stale-build reconciliation, config-push request ordering, and fail-closed reload-budget storage fallback across core/live-update.ts, core/lifecycle.ts, core/live-config.ts, and core/api-client.ts. The legitimate core scope increase is 175 instrumented lines (2462→2637); protocol, lifecycle, bootstrap-runtime, failed-capture generation/config/force fallback, mutation, modal, settings-transaction, storage, route, BFCache, accessibility, playback, and mobile event-order tests raise the reviewed high-water by 178 covered lines (2117→2295, 87.031%). A clean Node 22.20/V8 full-suite coverage run on 2026-07-25 passed all 1480 tests across 214 files and reproduced the expanded 2637-line scope. Retaining the one-line tolerance makes the minimum 2294/2637 (86.993%), which is stricter than both the prior 2117/2462 high-water percentage (85.987%) and its 2116/2462 tolerated floor (85.946%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

Smart Client Refresh hardening adds an allocation-free atomic configuration/revision snapshot, a server-bound no-store pre-loader bootstrap contract, strict fail-closed policy projection, current-tag middleware convergence, and a numeric compatibility successor for already-open legacy clients. The legitimate server scope increase is 44 instrumented lines (28556→28600); controller, service, anonymous-contract, loader-order, compatibility, and notifier tests raise the reviewed high-water by 47 covered lines (20148→20195, 70.612%). Repeated local .NET 10.0.9/Coverlet runs on 2026-07-24 passed all 1803 tests across the complete assembly and reproduced the expanded 28600-line scope. Retaining the reproduced four-line Coverlet concurrency tolerance makes the minimum 20191/28600 (70.598%), which is stricter than both the prior 20148/28556 high-water percentage (70.556%) and its 20144/28556 tolerated floor (70.542%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
